actions.tree: LineComment: // Length of each month (index 0 = January) in a non-leap year; February has 28 days. [5589,5674]
LineComment: // 2007 is not a leap year, so use the standard month lengths (February = 28). [10652,10730]
LineComment: // 2008 is a leap year; check January (31), February (29) and March (31). [10953,11026]
LineComment: // Only DAY_OF_MONTH (and a custom field backed by it) is supported; everything else is not. [12441,12533]
LineComment: // Day 31 only exists in months that have 31 days. [17119,17169]
LineComment: // Day 30 is valid in every month except February. [18281,18331]
LineComment: // Day 29 is valid in every month of a leap year (2012), but not February of a non-leap year (2011). [19443,19543]
LineComment: // Day 28 is valid in every month of every year. [20766,20814]
LineComment: // Adjusting Jan 1st with each day-of-month 1..31 should yield Jan 1st..Jan 31st. [22961,23042]
LineComment: // April has only 30 days, so day 31 cannot be applied. [23454,23509]
LineComment: // February 2007 has only 28 days, so day 29 cannot be applied. [23766,23829]
LineComment: // Day 31 is clamped down to each month's last valid day. [24598,24655]
LineComment: // Day 28 is valid in every month, so no clamping occurs. [25541,25598]
LineComment: // Day 31 is clamped down to each month's last valid day (months given as 1..12). [26850,26931]
LineComment: // Day 28 is valid in every month, so no clamping occurs (months given as 1..12). [27756,27837]
LineComment: // Day 31 is clamped down to each year-month's last valid day. [29104,29166]
LineComment: // Non-leap February clamps day 31 to the 28th. [30306,30353]
LineComment: // Day 28 is valid in every year-month, so no clamping occurs. [30509,30571]
LineComment: // For every pair of day-of-month values, compareTo must agree with the natural ordering of the ints. [32142,32243]
LineComment: // Each day-of-month value forms its own equality group; different values are never equal. [33594,33684]
LineComment: // A clock fixed to each day in January 2008 must report that day-of-month. [34630,34705]
LineComment: // of() must return the cached singleton for a given value. [9999,10058]
